widget.name: PDF Template Designer
widget.description: Design PDF templates by placing overlay fields on top of a base PDF.

property.caption: Template definition
property.description: Context object for FormConfiguration (or equivalent). Required in Designer mode and optional in other modes.

property.caption: Template JSON
property.description: LongString attribute that stores the template JSON.

property.caption: Base PDF datasource
property.description: Datasource that returns the base PDF FileDocument object. The widget uses the first item.

property.caption: Data JSON
property.description: LongString attribute that stores runtime field values as a JSON object.

property.caption: Field key schema JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString attribute containing a JSON Schema object for key options when Field key source is set to JSON.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Action executed whenever the template JSON changes from editor interactions.

property.caption: On save
property.description: Action executed after saving TemplateJson/DataJson (usually a commit microflow).

property.caption: Token context JSON
property.description: Optional String/LongString attribute with a flat {"token.key":"value"} JSON object (e.g. ClientDocument.PdfTokenContextJson). Tokens resolve in multi-variable text fields and prefill matching field keys in Viewer mode; user-entered values always win.

property.caption: View mode
property.description: Choose Designer (template editing), Viewer (interactive overlay fields), or Read-only PDF (PDF viewer only with no overlay fields).

property.caption: Show pages section
property.description: Show or hide the pages thumbnail section.

property.caption: Show palette section
property.description: Show or hide the palette section in the sidebar.

property.caption: Show fields section
property.description: Show or hide the fields list section in the sidebar.

property.caption: Show field properties
property.description: Show or hide the field properties panel.

property.caption: Show shortcut hints
property.description: Show or hide keyboard shortcut hints in the toolbar.

property.caption: Enable keyboard shortcuts
property.description: Enable keyboard shortcuts such as undo/redo, duplicate, delete, and nudging.

property.caption: Field key source
property.description: Choose how field keys are sourced. In dropdown modes, the palette lists keys for one-step placement and field properties use a key dropdown.

property.caption: Field key options datasource
property.description: Datasource that returns records containing allowed field key values for the key palette and key dropdown.

property.caption: Field key option attribute
property.description: Attribute that contains the key value to use in the dropdown.

property.caption: Show print button
property.description: Show a Print button in the toolbar that prints all PDF pages.

property.caption: Show import template button
property.description: Show an Import button that loads a template JSON file from disk onto the canvas (the user still clicks Save to persist). Hidden in Viewer/Read-only mode.

property.caption: Show replace PDF button
property.description: Show a Replace PDF button that uploads a new PDF file into the base PDF's file document, keeping the existing field layout. Hidden in Viewer/Read-only mode.

property.caption: Show header checkbox
property.description: Show or hide a checkbox in the header toolbar.

property.caption: Checkbox attribute
property.description: Boolean attribute from the widget context object that stores the header checkbox value.

property.caption: Checkbox label
property.description: Optional label shown next to the header checkbox. Leave empty to use 'Checkbox'.

property.caption: Show checkbox label
property.description: Show or hide the label next to the header checkbox.

property.caption: Header checkbox visible
property.description: Visibility expression for the header checkbox.

property.caption: Header checkbox editable
property.description: Editable expression for the header checkbox. The checkbox also respects the attribute's read-only state.

property.caption: Header checkbox on change
property.description: Action executed after the header checkbox value changes.

property.caption: Show save button
property.description: Show or hide the Save button in the toolbar. The button remains hidden in Read-only PDF mode.

property.caption: Save button text
property.description: Custom text for the Save button in the toolbar. Leave empty to use 'Save JSON'.

property.caption: Save button tooltip
property.description: Optional tooltip text for the Save button.

property.caption: Save button icon
property.description: Optional icon for the Save button.

property.caption: Save button render mode
property.description: Render the Save button as a button or link.

property.caption: Save button style
property.description: Visual style for the Save button.

property.caption: Save button tab index
property.description: Optional tab index for the Save button.

property.caption: Save button visible
property.description: Visibility expression for the Save button.

property.caption: Save button enabled
property.description: Enable or disable the Save button.

property.caption: Save button action
property.description: Optional action executed after the built-in save completes. When set, this overrides the legacy On save action under Data Source Bindings.

property.caption: PDF.js worker URL
property.description: Ignored since 0.4.0: pdf.js always loads from the app's pinned copy at /resources/pdfjs/<version>/ (shared with olari.PdfViewer). Kept so existing pages stay valid.

property.caption: PDF.js script URL
property.description: Ignored since 0.4.0: pdf.js always loads from the app's pinned copy at /resources/pdfjs/<version>/ (shared with olari.PdfViewer). Kept so existing pages stay valid.

property.caption: SigWeb script URL
property.description: Optional URL to SigWebTablet.js for external signature pad integration in Viewer mode.

property.caption: Viewer page layout
property.description: Viewer and Read-only PDF modes: Continuous stacks every page in one scrolling view (fields stay on their pages); Single page shows one page at a time with Prev/Next. Designer mode always shows one page.
